output.one_liner: SE Ranking is an SEO analytics platform providing programmatic access to keyword research, backlink analysis, domain insights, and AI search visibility data via REST API and MCP.

auth.notes: Static API key authentication via Authorization header (Token or Bearer prefix) or query parameter. OAuth 2.1 used for MCP server remote authentication.

evidence.snippet: Include an Authorization header in your request, with the value Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY
MCP server supports Streamable HTTP transports. This transport uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration

access.notes: 14-day free trial with 100K API credits, no credit card required. After trial expires, self-serve purchase of credit packs required for continued API access. API key issued immediately upon signup.

evidence.snippet: Yes. The 14-day free trial gives you 100K API credits across all six API endpoints, as well as MCP server access.
Instantly. Your API key is issued immediately after payment. If you are on a free trial, you'll get an API key once you confirm your email.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Data API: 10 RPS; Project API: 5 RPS; Trial accounts: 1 RPS. Custom rate limits available on request.

evidence.snippet: Data API Retrieving raw data (e.g., keywords, backlinks, domain analysis, website audit, AI Search). 10 requests per second (RPS)
All requests to the Data API must be authenticated. The base URL for all endpoints is: https://api.seranking.com
SE Ranking MCP: Use SE Ranking's live data inside any AI assistant. Put 180+ SEO tools behind every prompt
MCP server supports Streamable HTTP transports. This transport uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration for authentication at the following address: https://api.seranking.com/mcp

buildability.rationale: API is well-documented with self-serve free trial and clear REST endpoints, but production use requires paid plan after 14-day trial expires (credits are self-serve purchasable).

overview_evidence.snippet: SE Ranking API Programmatic access to real-time SEO & GEO data via SE Ranking's standalone API plan
One API for keywords, backlinks, domains, audits, AI search, and more. Start pay as you go or commit annually for volume discounts.
